name: Startup Bangladesh Limited
eligibility: Bangladesh-registered startups and impact enterprises with high growth potential or significant social impact; seed applicants should have an MVP tested in the market, while growth applicants should have commercial operations, traction and recurring revenue.
amount: BDT 25 lakh–5 crore per investment round
applicationPath: Complete the online Application for Investment form with company, founder, team, traction and pitch-deck information.
notes: Bangladesh's state-owned venture capital company invests through equity or quasi-equity and can co-invest in seed, early and growth-stage ventures. This route is for companies with a product and evidence of market progress, not idea-only projects seeking a grant.

name: iDEA Project, ICT Division
eligibility: Bangladeshi founders, teams or early-stage startups with an innovative, scalable ICT-based idea.
applicationPath: Choose Startup Grant at apply.idea.gov.bd and review the required documents before submitting.
notes: The ICT Division's iDEA Project provides non-equity grants to help technology ventures validate ideas, build an MVP and develop or expand the business. It also offers co-working space, labs, mentoring, training and networking; these support services have their own application routes.

name: Bangladesh Bank Startup Fund
eligibility: Bangladesh-registered startups whose founders are aged 21 or above. New ventures and startups operating for up to 12 years from registration can apply, subject to appraisal by a participating bank or financial institution.
amount: BDT 2–8 crore, depending on the startup's development stage
deadline: Rolling through participating banks and financial institutions
applicationPath: Apply through a participating bank or financial institution; applications are not submitted directly to Bangladesh Bank.
notes: Bangladesh Bank's BDT 500 crore refinance fund supports startup loans and investments through participating banks and financial institutions. The maximum interest or profit rate is 4%, subject to the lender's appraisal and conditions.
